subject.title: [Bug]: In msteams channel messages, OpenClaw can't access inbound attachments

question: Should Microsoft Teams non-personal Graph media fallback be automatic when no media is extracted from an HTML stub, or should group-chat fallback stay default-off behind `channels.msteams.graphMediaFallback` while channel URL fixes land separately?
rationale: Current main avoids noisy Graph lookups by requiring extracted attachment ids, but live evidence shows real Teams attachments can arrive without those ids; the default affects Graph call volume, permission expectations, diagnostics, and message-delivery behavior for existing deployments.

options.title: Accept narrow default-off group-chat opt-in
options.body: Land the group-chat fallback only after its scope is truly group-chat-only, and let the broader channel PR own team GUID and thread-reply URL repair.

options.title: Use one broader automatic fallback
options.body: Have one channel-owned fix relax the gate for non-personal Teams HTML stubs and accept the extra Graph lookup tradeoff without adding config.

options.title: Combine the open PRs first
options.body: Ask contributors to reconcile the group-chat gate, channel URL construction, and docs/config story in one canonical branch before merge.

recommendation.title: Accept narrow default-off group-chat opt-in
recommendation.body: Land the group-chat fallback only after its scope is truly group-chat-only, and let the broader channel PR own team GUID and thread-reply URL repair.

likelyOwner.reason: @steipete has the strongest recent history across the msteams plugin boundary and the remaining choice is a config/product default tradeoff.
